title: South Florida Weekend Guide: Free First, Then Dinner and Nightlife
igCaption:
Start with the community events, then plan dinner and Halloween drinks.

Sources: Florida Today, Miami New Times, The Palm Beach Post, Sun Sentinel, Eater Miami

#SouthFlorida #FortLauderdale #DelrayBeach #WeekendGuide

scenes.text: Looking for a South Florida weekend plan that starts with community events and ends with dinner or drinks?
Start with the No Kings protests. Florida Today lists event locations in Florida for this weekend, including Fort Lauderdale.
scenes.caption: Start with the No Kings protests. Florida Today lists event locations in Florida for this weekend, including Fort Lauderdale.

scenes.text: Delray Beach has a farewell dinner stop. Park Tavern at 32 SE Second Ave. closes Sunday, October 18, after more than 15 years. It opened in 2012 and became known for happy hour and a from-scratch kitchen.

scenes.text: Also in Delray, the Palm Beach Post has a dinner fundraiser supporting foster children. At that fundraiser, open NEAR and see who else showed up.

scenes.text: For nightlife, Broward has Halloween options. The Sun Sentinel’s adult party guide covers haunted houses, costumes, and cocktails across South Florida.

scenes.text: If you want dinner before the late stuff, Brickell has updated restaurant options. Eater’s October guide adds The Mexican, Seia, and Nuna, and lists Elcielo with an 18-course tasting menu from chef Juan Manuel Barrientos.
